GDC's Mark DeLoura addresses the event's dip in attendance in 2026 as he details the planned changes for 2027

The organisers of the Game Developers Conference (GDC) Festival of Gaming are not unduly phased about the 30% drop in attendance the event witnessed in 2026.

GDC State of the Game Industry report: 40% of developers are using generative AI for work

40% of developers are using generative AI in their work, according to the latest State of the Game Industry report from the Game Developers Conference (GDC).

text:
"It's about giving more great games a chance" – Why Launchable thinks it can help more independent studios reach the market with its shared success model

A new platform called Launchable aims to connect studios with development talent and publishing services using a "shared-success framework". In other words, developers provide their services on the understanding that they will receive a revenue share later on, once the game launches.

Resident Evil Requiem wins four Golden Joystick Awards, including Ultimate and Console GOTY

The 44th Golden Joystick Awards took place last night, with Resident Evil Requiem winning four awards including Ultimate Game of the Year and Console Game of the Year.

text:
German Games Industry Association warns Digital Fairness Act could cause "double regulation and legal uncertainty"

The German Games Industry Association (Game) has criticised the Digital Fairness Act (DFA), warning that the legislation creates "double regulation and legal uncertainty" that could significantly harm European developers.

Eve Online maker Fenris Creations is adding a rendering technique to its open-source Carbon engine that promises more accurate shading and greater depth

Having open-sourced its Carbon engine earlier this year, Eve Online creator Fenris Creations is making a sizeable addition to the tech in the form of CORTAO.

Black Forest Games spins out from THQ Nordic, co-founds indie studio group Third Signal

Black Forest Games has separated from THQ Nordic through a management buyout and co-founded an independent game studio group, Third Signal.

Laid-off Id Software devs form employee-owned studio Hidden Horses

A group of Id Software developers affected by Xbox's mass layoffs have formed an independent, employee-owned studio called Hidden Horses.
